title: Ye Qing's Secret Contact
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing's conditions put Chen Ji in a dilemma: trading help for the Demonic Path in exchange for Chen Nian's survival—just how should he make this choice?

text.content: Midnight, all was silent. Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a massive stone at Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm glowing with a cold, eerie light. He had been deducing the connection between the traitor and the humiliation of the cancelled engagement when a faint, lingering scent of blood interrupted him. Looking up, a black shadow like a ghost darted from the forest and landed three zhang away. The newcomer wore a black veil over their face, their slender form emanating a terrifying Demonic Path aura—Ye Qing had come in person. Chen Ji's gaze flickered; he mused internally: the Saint of the Demonic Path infiltrating the heart of a righteous sect in the dead of night—if not for some earth-shattering matter, she would never dare such an audacity. His expression unchanged, still wearing that cowardlytrashdisciple facade, he drawled: "Ye Qing Saint, what an interesting midnight stroll. Lost your way, or... specifically came to visit this useless one for old times' sake?" The words carried mockery, but a sharp glint had already passed through his eyes.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing removed the black veil, revealing a face of cold, breathtaking beauty. Her brow held less of its usual flamboyance, gaining a rare gravity as she said: "Chen Ji, I have no time for verbal sparring. The Holy Sect's movements are faster than I anticipated—the Heavenly Fate Lock Key ritual... has been moved up." She paused, her gaze burning as she stared at Chen Ji: "Your sister Chen Nian, on the full moon three days from now, will be sacrificed as an offering. At that time..." She didn't finish, but the unsaid meaning made Chen Ji's heart contract violently.

Chen Ji's fingertips trembled subtly, yet his face maintained that calm facade. He rose slowly, his voicecalm得有些可怕: "Three days... seven days earlier than my calculations. At the Holy Sect, who is orchestrating this ritual?" He spoke their name directly, his tone betraying no panic, but Ye Qing clearly saw that the fist hidden in his sleeve had clenched white at the knuckles. This man, clearly caring desperately, could still maintain this harmlesstrashdisciple act—something unexpectedly admirable stirred in her heart.

Ye Qing drew a yellowed silk scroll from her sleeve, unfurling it to reveal an intricately detailed formation diagram. She handed the scroll to Chen Ji, her voice extremely low: "This is the Holy Sect's layout plan, covering the ritual location, guard positions, and... the altar's weaknesses." She pointed to a spot marked with a blood-red X: "The core of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key ritual lies in the word 'lock'—they will use your sister's soul to lock Heaven's Qi Fortune. Destroying this 'lock' will cause the ritual to fail. But the problem is..." She met Chen Ji's gaze directly: "Surrounding the altar are at least three Nascent Soul realm elders, plus over twenty Holy Sect direct disciples. With your current cultivation, rushing in would be suicide."

text.content: Chen Ji accepted the scroll, his gaze scanning every inch of the formation diagram. His memory was exceptional to begin with, and the Tianji Record's assistance allowed him to etch every detail into his mind. A moment later, he rolled up the scroll and stored it in his chest, a faint smile curving his lips: "Ye Qing Saint, you risked coming here late at night, surely not just to deliver intelligence?" His tone carried playful undertones: "Tell me, what does the Demonic Path want from me?" Ye Qing paused slightly, then revealed a bitter smile: "You're indeed clever. The Holy Sect and the Demonic Path, seemingly mortal enemies, actually... they have always been using us." She took a deep breath: "I need you to shield the Demonic Path from a fatal blow by the righteous path at a critical moment. In exchange—" she said solemnly: "On the day of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key ritual, the Demonic Path will spare no effort to help you rescue your person."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent. What exactly did Ye Qing's 'critical moment' refer to? What would shielding the Demonic Path from the righteous path's strike entail? His mind raced, the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm faintly warming, as if warning him of something. His sister Chen Nian, the girl who had been missing for years, kidnapped by the Holy Sect, was now walking step by step toward death. And this woman before him was his only source of leads. "Ye Qing," he suddenly spoke, his voice low: "I only want to know one thing—are you genuinely wishing to cooperate with me, or are you a piece of the Holy Sect?" The question was too direct; Ye Qing visibly startled. Looking at this 'trash,' she suddenly discovered his eyes were far deeper than she had imagined.

Ye Qing was silent for a long while. When she spoke again, there was an unnoticeable tremor in her voice: "A piece?" She gave a soft laugh, the sound full of self-mockery: "In the eyes of the Holy Sect, I have always been nothing more than a piece to be used and discarded." She slowly lifted her sleeve, revealing a ferocious black marking on her wrist: "This is the 'Heart-Devouring Gu' implanted by the Holy Sect. It acts up every full moon, causing me unbearable agony. They use this to control me, making me do their dirty work." She lowered her sleeve, her gaze returning to Chen Ji: "I don't know what secrets you hold, but I know... you are my only hope to escape all this."

text.content: Chen Ji watched Ye Qing silently. At this moment, he suddenly realized that this Demonic Path Saint was not as cold and ruthless as the rumors suggested. She was merely a poor soul caught in the currents of fate, no different in essence from thistrashstruggling to survive in the cracks. He sighed softly, took a jade bottle from his chest, and tossed it to Ye Qing: "This is a method to suppress the Gu poison I acquired incidentally—it lasts seven days. Consider it... a deposit." Ye Qing caught the bottle, surprise flickering in her eyes before transforming into deep emotion. She parted her lips as if to say something, ultimately simply nodding solemnly.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to gaze at the night sky, the stars desolate like chess pieces. He said in a deep voice: "Ye Qing, I've noted your conditions. But there's one thing you must understand—" He turned back, his gaze sharp as a blade: "If you dare deceive me, even if you're the Demonic Path Saint, I'll make you understand what 'playing dumb to eat the tiger' means." The words were light, yet they inexplicably sent a chill down Ye Qing's spine. She suddenly recalled that this 'trash' had played Han Lie, the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, like a fiddle. The night deepened; Ye Qing replaced her black veil, preparing to leave. Before departing, she suddenly looked back: "Chen Ji, one more thing—the traitor colluding with the Holy Sect, his name is Lin Xiao." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Lin Xiao, that Lin Family young lord who had publicly humiliated him and forced the cancellation of his engagement ten years ago!

choice.prompt: Lin Xiao's appearance resurrected Chen Ji's humiliation from a decade ago. Faced with this individual who was both a traitor and an old adversary, how should he respond?

choices.text: Endure and Lie in Wait, Secretly Strategize
choices.description: Lin Xiao's strength is formidable; this is not the time to stir the snake. Evidence should be gathered secretly, waiting for the moment to strike a fatal blow.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a More Complete Chain of Evidence
choices.risk_hint: Lin Xiao May Detect Your Intentions

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging hatred within him. The humiliation of the cancelled engagement ten years ago, he had never forgotten. But Lin Xiao was now a Golden Core realm expert, backed by the Holy Sect—no confrontation now would be like an egg striking a rock. He narrowed his eyes, saying coldly: "Lin Xiao... very well, let's see how long you can continue acting so smug." Watching from the side, Ye Qing was internally startled: this man, when angry, was actually even more terrifying than when calm.

choices.text: Take the Initiative, Lure the Snake Out of Its Hole
choices.description: Exploit Lin Xiao's arrogant nature, deliberately reveal a flaw to provoke him into action, exposing his true face before everyone.
choices.visible_reward: Publicly Humiliate to Wash Away Past Disgrace
choices.risk_hint: May Fall Into the Opponent's Trap

text.content: A cold smile curved at the corner of Chen Ji's lips, dangerous light flickering in his eyes: "Since Lin Xiao likes to play, then I'll accompany him." He turned to Ye Qing: "Saint, could you help spread some news? Just say that thistrashunexpectedly obtained a heaven-shaking opportunity..." Ye Qing's eyes brightened; she clearly guessed his intention. She nodded in agreement, her estimation of this man rising several notches—how could this be atrash? Clearly a beast lying in wait!

choices.text: Borrow Strength to Strike, Redirect the Calamity Eastward
choices.description: Leak the evidence of Lin Xiao's collusion with the Holy Sect to other forces, using their hands to kill the enemy and reap the benefits.
choices.visible_cost: Need to recruit a third party force
choices.visible_reward: Eliminate the enemy without expending a single soldier
choices.risk_hint: May be bitten back by the third party

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze deep and profound: "Since Lin Xiao has colluded with the Holy Sect, he is a traitor to the Xuanwu Sect. If I were to reveal this to the people of the Xuanwu Sect..." He didn't finish, but Ye Qing had already grasped his meaning. Han Lie, that simple-minded yet unbelievably powerful Xuanwu prodigy, despised betrayal above all else. Chen Ji needed only a subtle push to make these two fight to the death. Ye Qing sighed softly: "Chen Ji, your schemes... truly terrifying."

dialogue.content: After Ye Qing departed, Chen Ji stood alone atop the mountain peak, the night wind brushing past his robes, creating rustling sounds. In his mind, Chen Nian's blurred face kept flashing—the visions from the Tianji Record always became fragmented whenever they involved Chen Nian, as if shrouded in a layer of mist. This girl whom the Holy Sect called the "Heavenly Fate Key"—what secrets did she carry? He closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking into the Tianji Record Fragment. Upon the fragment, runes flowed, and a blurry scene emerged: on a night of full moon, a blood-colored altar, a young girl bound by iron chains, her eyes filled with fear and despair...

text.content: Chen Ji猛地 opened his eyes, fine beads of sweat already forming on his forehead. Every glimpse of heavenly secrets came at the cost of Heavenly Fate Value, and this vision, though incomplete, had cost him dearly. Yet he had captured some crucial information: the southeastern corner of the altar was the weakest point in the entire formation; and during the final step of the ritual, the presiding Elder would experience a brief moment of weakness—that was the only chance to break the局. He silently memorized the information and began deducing each move of the chess game in his mind.

choice.prompt: Three days passed in the blink of an eye. Before the action, Chen Ji needed final preparations. How should he allocate this precious time?

choices.text: Cultivate and break through to increase Combat Power
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record Fragment to comprehend the mysteries of heaven's way, attempting to break through the current realm, even if there's only a sliver of hope.
choices.visible_cost: Consume vast amounts of time and energy

text.content: Chen Ji found a secluded cave, sat cross-legged. The Tianji Record Fragment floated before him, and between the flowing runes, strands of heavenly dao气息 were drawn into his body. This was an extremely dangerous process—the power of the Tianji Record was not meant for mortals to withstand, every absorption was like dancing on the edge of a blade. But he had no other choice. On the altar three days later, he must possess enough power to protect himself.

choices.text: Recruit allies to face danger together
choices.description: Contact Su Qingyao, reveal partial truth, request her support.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may oppose the risky endeavor

text.content: After careful deliberation, Chen Ji decided to meet Su Qingyao. This woman had always suspected his true identity yet never truly exposed him. If there was anyone within the Tianqing Sect worth trusting, she might be one. He quietly arrived at Su Qingyao's residence and knocked on her door. Moments later, the door opened, Su Qingyao stood in simple robes, a hint of surprise flickering in her eyes: "Chen Ji? You come at night. What brings you here?"

choices.text: Infiltrate and scout, formulate meticulous plan
choices.description: Scout the ritual location in advance, map out the terrain and guard distribution, develop a foolproof action plan.
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, will lose the initiative

text.content: Chen Ji executed the art of concealment, slipping away from Tianqing Sect and infiltrating toward Holy Sect territory. Though Ye Qing's formation diagram was detailed, only on-site reconnaissance could reveal more intricacies. He spent a full two days mapping every detail of the terrain around the altar, guard shift changes, patrol routes—all catalogued. This intelligence would become his crucial leverage for the rescue.

dialogue.content: Just as Chen Ji was making meticulous preparations, an elderly voice suddenly rang in his mind: "Boy, you've lost your head to haste." It was Mo Xiansheng. Chen Ji froze for a moment, then steadied his mind, asking within his heart: "Master, what do you mean?" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of resignation: "The Heavenly Fate Lock Key... the thing on that girl is far more complex than you can imagine. If you act recklessly, not only will you fail to save her, but you'll drag the entire Tianqing Sect into the abyss." Chen Ji's heart tightened, pressing urgently: "What do you mean, Master—" Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before speaking: "The time isn't ripe, Heavenly Secrets cannot be revealed. But I can tell you this much... that girl's fate and your fate have long been bound together."

Mo Xiansheng's words were like a basin of cold water, bringing Chen Ji back to his senses. He took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," "Heavenly Fate Lock Key"... these four characters echoed repeatedly in his mind. The Holy Sect spared no expense, mobilizing three Nascent Soul stage elders and over twenty core disciples, all for a single ceremony—what were they trying to lock away? The workings of Heaven, or some secret that should never be known to the world? What role did his sister Chen Nian play in this grand scheme? Countless questions flooded his mind in an instant.

text.content: Night deepened, and Chen Ji sat alone by the window, gazing at the gradually waxing moon on the horizon. Three days... only three days left. His fingers tapped rhythmically against the desk. In his mind, countless thoughts tangled together like hemp rope: Lin Xiao's betrayal, Ye Qing's conditions for exchange, Su Qingyao's suspicions, Mo Xiansheng's warnings... each thread of evidence pointed toward an increasingly massive chess game, and he, Chen Ji, seemed from the very beginning to have been pushed forward by an invisible hand. The Eye of Heaven's Mandate... that ultimate villain, was it watching his every move from some dark corner right now? A chill of bone-deep coldness suddenly washed over Chen Ji.

choice.prompt: Faced with Mo Xiansheng's warning and the perplexing situation, Chen Ji needed to make his final decision: whether to proceed with the original plan or not?

choices.text: Rush in regardless, forcibly rescue the person
choices.description: No matter the truth, Chen Nian is his only remaining kin in this world. Even if dragon's pool and tiger's den lay ahead, he would charge right through.
choices.visible_reward: Probability of successfully rescuing his sister greatly increases

text.content: Chen Ji猛地站起身，眼中闪过一抹determined。不管墨先生说的是真是假，他都不能眼睁睁看着陈念去死。这个世界上，他可以失去一切，唯独不能失去她。"妹妹……等着我。"他whispered呢喃，眸中寒芒乍现，"就算是天道要收你，哥哥也要把你从天道手里抢回来！"这一刻，他那trash面具下的真实面目，终于彻底显露——这是一个为了至亲可以与天为敌的男人。

choices.description: 墨先生的warning不可忽视。与其贸然行动，不如先弄清"天命锁钥"的真正含义，再做定夺。
choices.risk_hint: 错过最佳救援the right moment

text.content: 陈机slowly闭上眼，将那股冲动硬生生压了回去。他是一个谋定而后动的人，绝不会因为一时的感情用事而坏了全盘计划。"墨先生，"他在心中问道，"您既然知道天命锁钥的秘密，可否告诉我——我妹妹身上的"锁"，究竟是什么？"墨先生沉默良久，方才sighing道："此事……待你完成这一卷的目标，老夫自会告诉你。但现在，你只需记住一点——那锁匙一旦开启，释放的并非你妹妹的魂魄，而是……"他的声音戛然而止，仿佛被什么力量阻断。

choices.text: 采取双管齐下的策略，做好充分准备
choices.description: 一方面按原计划准备救人，另一方面设法从圣宗内部获取更多情报，知己知彼方能百战不殆。

text.content: 陈机睁开眼，眸光恢复了往日的深邃与calm。他从来不是那种走极端的人，既然有第三条路可选，为何非要二选一？他再次取出夜清给他的那卷绢帛，目光落在布阵图的某个角落——那里标注着一处隐秘的通道，似乎是祭坛的备用入口。他嘴角微扬，一个大胆的计划在脑海中逐渐成形：若能让夜清的人从那处通道潜入，同时自己在正面吸引火力……胜算将大大增加。

随着月圆之夜渐近，天地间弥漫着一股难以名状的suppressed气息。陈机伫立在天青宗山门之前，凝视着远方黑沉沉的天际，嘴角勾起一抹meaningful的弧度。圣宗、林霄、天命锁钥、魔道圣女……所有棋子均已就位，而他陈机，终于要在这盘大局中落下关键一子。他whispered自语："妹妹，别怕。哥哥来了。"话音未落，天际suddenly闪过一道刺目电光，仿佛天道在回应他的誓言——亦或在嘲笑他的自不量力。
